question: Among all races held in Italy, find the driver who achieved the fastest lap (lowest milliseconds) and return their full name, nationality, and the race name and year.

       T2."XCL_039" AS surname,
       T2."XCL_041" AS nationality,
       T3."XCL_069" AS race_name,
       T3."XCL_066" AS year
FROM lapTimes AS T1
INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1."XCL_044" = T2."XCL_034"
INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T1."XCL_043" = T3."XCL_065"
INNER JOIN circuits AS T4 ON T3."XCL_068" = T4."XCL_001"
WHERE T4."XCL_005" = 'Italy'

ORDER BY T1."XCL_048" ASC
LIMIT 1
